description: scores/keybindings.json (gitignored runtime player record; no data/ content file pairs with this schema - validate_data skips data/schemas/, the highscores.schema.json precedent). One key string per rebindable action, resolved by engine/input.py + game/main.py's _binding_key_name. Written ONLY through engine.input.save_keybindings; the shipped DEFAULT for each action lives in data/balancing/ui.json Keybindings, which must declare the exact same property set as this schema.

combat_speed_1.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 1x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

combat_speed_2.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 1.5x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

combat_speed_3.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 2x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

confirm_purchase.description: Confirms whatever construct/move preview modal is currently open - the same effect as clicking its CONFIRM button. No effect when no such modal is open.

end_turn.description: Ends the BUILDING phase early - the dev-convenience keyboard mirror of the End Turn button, gated by the same Session/tutorial checks.

quick_skip_combat.description: Abandons the current wave straight to ROUND_END, paying no XP for the enemies skipped. Not shown on the in-game Controls screen (a testing convenience, not a player-facing control), but still dispatched through this same binding.

toggle_cheat_menu.description: Opens/closes the cheat menu. Works over the LEVELUP modal, never on GAME_OVER. Not shown on the in-game Controls screen (a hidden dev feature), but still dispatched through this same binding.

toggle_drag_select.description: Toggles the DRAG SEL box-selection mode - the same flag the DRAG SEL HUD button flips on click.

toggle_heatmap.description: Toggles the HEATMAP map overlay - the same flag the HEATMAP HUD pill flips on click.

toggle_range.description: Toggles the RANGE map overlay - the same flag the RANGE HUD pill flips on click.

toggle_tier_overview.description: Toggles the TIERS map overlay - the same flag the TIERS HUD pill flips on click.

zoom_level_1.description: Sets the camera zoom to the 1st (smallest-scale) data-driven zoom level (core.json Camera.zoom_levels, sorted ascending), keeping the viewport-centre world point fixed - the same recentring step_zoom uses.

zoom_level_2.description: Sets the camera zoom to the 2nd data-driven zoom level (core.json Camera.zoom_levels, sorted ascending), keeping the viewport-centre world point fixed. A no-op if fewer than 2 levels are authored.

zoom_level_3.description: Sets the camera zoom to the 3rd (largest-scale) data-driven zoom level (core.json Camera.zoom_levels, sorted ascending), keeping the viewport-centre world point fixed. A no-op if fewer than 3 levels are authored.
